items.title: 11-year-old, other minors among 11 shot near Florida A&M University stadium
items.brief: A shooting near the football stadium at Florida A&M University in Tallahassee left 11 people with gunshot wounds Saturday night, officials said.

items.title: Presidential race in Bulgaria heads to runoff due to record low turnout
items.brief: The presidential election in Bulgaria on Sunday ended inconclusively, with the next head of state to be picked in a runoff, according to election officials.

items.title: Ammonia contamination prompts evacuations after Oregon seafood plant fire, officials say
items.brief: Ammonia contamination after a seafood plant fire prompted recommended evacuations in a coastal Oregon city, local officials said Sunday morning.

items.title: Leftist Lula and Trump ally Bolsonaro await voters’ decision in tight Brazil runoff election
items.brief: Polls in Brazil’s presidential runoff election have closed after voting was extended by two hours on Sunday following last-minute pleas from both candidates to electoral authorities.
